_comment: Windows, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 via lxe's dsx 2-bit build (lxe/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-dsx-2bit, base 1017, its 4 GGUF shards merged into one file with tools/xolotl/gguf_merge_shards.py (the expert tier reads a single-file GGUF)), its expert-rank.json converted to rank-dsx.bin, the official 1017 Engram shards read in place, the 1017 tokenizer files. DSpark: the 1017 checkpoint's own draft (mtp.0-2), built on Windows with tools/v41/v41_sidecar.py and v41_sidecar_requant (Q2_K, 5.66 GB); acceptance on the round-5 prompts matches the September draft's (code 3.67 vs 3.70, agent 2.96 vs 2.78, prose 1.67 vs 1.71 tokens/pass). Tuned settings as the other Windows configs (72 GiB arena, tier-batch PCIe 0.75). Routing: the plain model name decodes with the light nudge (--route-bias 0.25 / --route-bias-file 0.15, 19.1 tok/s avg on the 3090, 26% of expert picks differ from exact routing); -fast = 0.5 / 0.3 (21.7 tok/s, 37%); -exact = no nudge (9.7 tok/s). Measured 2026-10-18, local-ai/dsv41/bench/abba-smart.json. STRATA_RB_SMART=1 builds the smart router: the per-request route_protect / route_pool keys and the route meter line per request; with both keys 0 it selects exactly as the flat bias.
